front.title: Using Dummy IPv4 Address and Node Identification Extensions for IP/ICMP translators (XLATs)

abstract.t: This document suggests that when a source IPv6 address of an ICMPv6 message can not be translated to an IPv4 address, and the protocol translator does not have any public IPv4 addresses available to source the translated packet from, the translator uses the dummy IPv4 address (192.0.0.8) to translate the IPv6 source address. This document updates RFC6791, Stateless Source Address Mapping for ICMPv6 Packets, and RFC7915, IP/ICMP Translation Algorithm, by proposing to utilize the ICMP extension for Node Identification (draft-ietf- intarea-extended-icmp-nodeid) to carry the original IPv6 source address of ICMPv6 messages.
